tests.name: Required repository assets
tests.expected: Stage/Dimension scripts and loader files exist

tests.name: Verify database engine
tests.expected: Use repository's configured database
tests.actual: PostgreSQL 17; no SQL Server service configured
tests.note: The supplied task mentions SQL Server; this suite follows the repository configuration.

tests.name: Required connection settings are present
tests.expected: Required variable names configured; values kept private

tests.name: Docker Compose configuration parses
tests.expected: docker compose config --quiet succeeds

tests.name: Write-impact scripts identified and excluded
tests.expected: Runner does not invoke ETL or mutating scripts
tests.actual: create script contains DROP TABLE=True; load script contains DML=True

tests.name: Required Compose services are running
tests.expected: Postgres service running

tests.name: PostgreSQL query client is available
tests.expected: psql available through the running Postgres service

tests.name: Connect to PostgreSQL
tests.expected: Connection succeeds using configured settings

tests.name: Read-only transaction enforced
tests.expected: transaction_read_only=on

tests.name: Trip Stage table exists and is readable
tests.expected: stage.stg_yellow_taxi_trips exists and can be queried
tests.note: Row estimate is planner metadata, not an exact count.

tests.name: Zone Lookup Stage table exists and is readable
tests.expected: stage.stg_taxi_zone_lookup exists and can be queried
tests.note: Row estimate is planner metadata, not an exact count.

tests.name: ETL control table exists and is readable
tests.expected: control.etl_control exists and can be queried
tests.note: Row estimate is planner metadata, not an exact count.

tests.name: Source inputs and loader files are available
tests.expected: Zone CSV and Mage loader present; no source download performed
tests.note: Missing Parquet files are normally downloaded by the loader; this smoke test does not download or load them.

tests.name: Schema contract for stage.stg_yellow_taxi_trips
tests.expected: Expected columns and PostgreSQL types match DDL

tests.name: Schema contract for stage.stg_taxi_zone_lookup
tests.expected: Expected columns and PostgreSQL types match DDL

tests.name: Required audit fields are non-null by schema
tests.expected: source_file_name and load_datetime are NOT NULL on both Stage tables

tests.name: Successful ETL control rows reconcile
tests.expected: Successful batches have rows_read=rows_loaded and rows_rejected=0

tests.name: Stage quality profile metrics

tests.note: Omitted by default to avoid an unplanned full scan of the large trip table.

tests.name: Source row numbers are unique per file
